en: A color illustration of a riverside town with red‑roofed wooden and brick houses, a small arched bridge over a canal, boats moored along the water, and a prominent church with a tall, slender spire in the background. Trees line the waterfront, and larger, more monumental buildings rise behind the older town. In the lower left corner there is a short printed caption in a decorative script.
